title: Time interval identification
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the effective time interval between photographed positions as 0.20 s (4 flashes).

title: Horizontal motion analysis
description: Important: Recognizes that horizontal displacement between positions equals initial horizontal velocity multiplied by time interval.

title: Vertical motion analysis
description: Important: Applies constant acceleration equations to determine vertical displacements between successive positions.

title: Pythagorean application
description: Important: Uses Pythagorean theorem to relate segment lengths s₁ and s₂ to horizontal and vertical displacements.

title: Ratio equation setup
description: Essential: Correctly sets up and solves the ratio equation s₁/s₂ = 3/7 using displacement components.

title: Final velocity calculation
description: Essential: Calculates and presents the final answer as v₀ = 2√5/5 m/s (or equivalent decimal/numerical form).

title: Incorrect time interval
description: Pitfall: Uses 0.05 s instead of 0.20 s for time between photographed positions.

title: Sign error in vertical motion
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign convention for gravitational acceleration in displacement equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculation and includes units in final answer.
